name: desktop-recorder-mcp
description: Agent Record for your AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, VS Code, OpenCode and Claude Desktop), in one package: agent-desktop and agent-browser built from the unmodified vercel-labs sources, plus a background-only mode (never your mouse, keyboard or focus), record, saved passwords and Desktop Recorder (record a task and play it again, without AI). Nothing else is downloaded or installed. Windows now; macOS and Linux coming soon.
